text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yippee! I won! I got first!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Heehee, that was such a short race. I
won before I
knew it!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Plus, it felt so good being in the front! ♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
choice_data_list: 緊張しないで、よく頑張った！
choice_data_list_en: You didn't let your nerves get to you—great job!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Nope! It was as fun as ever!
choice_data_list: 雰囲気、いつもと違っただろ？
雰囲気、いつもと違ったでしょ？
choice_data_list_en: The vibe was different from usual, right?
The vibe was different from usual, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Every race is a blast! So I just try my best
and
have fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter the race, Haru Urara is always
the
same. I'd say that's one of her strong
suits,
except...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being a little nervous can actually result
in a
better performance. So I decide to
recommend
that she take on a higher
level race.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
choice_data_list_en: How about entering a GⅠ next?
Want to enter a GⅠ next?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Such a cool name! Yeah, let's do it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she's surrounded by hard workers,
maybe it'll
change her mindset!
choice_data_list: ……『フェブラリーステークス』はどうだ？
……『フェブラリーステークス』はどう？

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
February Stakes? I feel like I've heard
that
before... But oh well!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Sure, let's try this Fairly Lovely Steaks
race!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Isn't that what I said? These race
names are
so hard...
choice_data_list: 『フェブラリーステークス』な！
『フェブラリーステークス』ね！

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Febru... Febu.. ri... Fairly... What was it
again?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We decide on the next race to shoot for.

However...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara doesn't seem to take anything seriously. I wonder how hard she'll actually compete...
